disposition.summary: Neural ATSM is the Interspeech 2024 text-conditioned phoneme-rate / learned TSM system. The paper and research screens are available as source-reported context only. Locally absent and unverified: runnable official code, weights, runtime, exact audio geometry, terms, rights-cleared text/audio inputs, matched cohort, output and rate result.

historical_evidence.boundary: The follow-up scorecard names Neural ATSM as a text-conditioned phoneme-rate / learned TSM system, inspected at paper and artifact level only, and records no runnable lightweight audio-only controller artifact.

Records that the Interspeech 2024 system predicts phoneme-level rates from text, includes learned audio generation/resynthesis, and that no official executable lightweight waveform-to-rate module or checkpoint was identified in that evaluation.

Describes sentence text -> phoneme-level rate with learned upsampling/attention and VAE/flow reconstruction, records no official runnable code or weights, and marks it research-only / not runnable here.
Marks neural-atsm as considered, disposition sdk-model and verification_profile rate; it is not a result.
Defines the Rate profile requirements. No rate measurement, control, pitch, buffering, preservation or device-timing record exists for Neural ATSM.
